cases.title: returns undefined when --host is absent
cases.reason: Absent host flag retains no-selection semantics.

cases.title: rejects a --host flag with no value
cases.reason: Valueless flag is rejected rather than interpreted as a host alias.

cases.title: rejects the unparseable host id %s
cases.reason: Empty runtime/SSH IDs, unsafe separator and whitespace are rejected; all four parameter inputs read individually.

cases.title: parameter: 'runtime:'
cases.reason: Malformed host value must fail actual parser before routing.

cases.title: parameter: 'ssh:'
cases.reason: Malformed host value must fail actual parser before routing.

cases.title: parameter: 'ssh:a|b'
cases.reason: Malformed host value must fail actual parser before routing.

cases.title: parameter: '   '
cases.reason: Malformed host value must fail actual parser before routing.

cases.title: parses the three supported host kinds
cases.reason: Local, SSH and runtime inputs preserve their distinct target kinds and runtime identity.

cases.title: carries an unprefixed host name through as an alias
cases.reason: Unprefixed display name and whitespace-trimmed spelling survive as unresolved aliases.

cases.title: keeps the current connection for local and ssh hosts
cases.reason: Local and SSH targets keep the connection local and avoid pairing-store enumeration.

cases.title: routes a paired runtime host to that environment
cases.reason: Paired runtime identity selects the exact environment.

cases.title: rejects a runtime host id that no paired environment owns
cases.reason: Unknown runtime identity fails loudly instead of silently selecting the local runtime.

cases.title: accepts the environment name as well as its id
cases.reason: Human paired-server name canonicalizes to the environment identity.

cases.title: decodes percent-encoded environment ids
cases.reason: Percent-encoded identity is decoded before matching the pairing store.

cases.title: refuses a runtime host alongside --pairing-code
cases.reason: Runtime target plus pairing code is refused instead of choosing one server silently.

cases.title: refuses a runtime host that disagrees with --environment
cases.reason: Explicit conflicting environment selector is rejected.

cases.title: names the ambient variable when ORCA_ENVIRONMENT is the conflicting selector
cases.reason: Conflicting ambient selector names the actual environment variable and value for recovery.

cases.title: hands an agent the known environment ids to retry with
cases.reason: Unknown runtime selection exposes independent known environment identities in machine-readable data.

cases.title: accepts ORCA_ENVIRONMENT naming the runtime host in another case
cases.reason: Case-insensitive ambient match canonicalizes without invoking the exact-only fallback store resolver.

cases.title: accepts --environment naming the same server as the runtime host
cases.reason: Environment selector for the same paired server remains accepted.

cases.title: routes an alias that names a paired server to that environment
cases.reason: Bare server alias resolves only after the SSH collision check finds none.

cases.title: leaves an alias that names no paired server to the SSH axis
cases.reason: Alias missing from pairing store remains available to connected-runtime SSH resolution.

cases.title: resolves an alias to the SSH target that carries that label
cases.reason: Actual target resolver maps a known label to its distinct machine-generated SSH identity.

cases.title: names the alias the caller typed rather than an ssh: spelling they did not use
cases.reason: Unknown bare alias is echoed as typed in the error rather than rewritten to an SSH-prefixed spelling.

cases.title: refuses an alias that names a machine on both axes
cases.reason: Cross-axis name collision refuses dispatch and offers both explicit host identities.

cases.title: refuses an alias naming a server and two SSH targets sharing a label
cases.reason: Two SSH targets sharing the server label are additional ambiguity; all three explicit identities are offered.

cases.title: refuses an alias two paired servers answer to
cases.reason: Duplicated paired-server name refuses first-match guessing.

cases.title: refuses to route an alias to a paired server when SSH targets cannot be read
cases.reason: Unreadable SSH targets cannot establish unambiguous paired-server routing; recovery offers the explicit server ID.

cases.title: resolves the local row name to --host local
cases.reason: Case-insensitive local display name resolves to local in both environment and target phases.

cases.title: refuses the local row name when an SSH target carries it too
cases.reason: Local display name colliding with an SSH label refuses selection and exposes both axes.

cases.title: refuses the local row name when a paired server carries it too
cases.reason: Local display name colliding with a paired server refuses selection.

cases.title: resolves an SSH target label that contains spaces
cases.reason: Spaced SSH display name matches case-insensitively and returns the exact target ID.

cases.title: ignores one pair of wrapping quotes around a host name
cases.reason: Literal wrapping quotes from native Windows-style argv are removed for paired alias and explicit local spelling; no real shell launch is claimed.

cases.title: leaves an alias to the routed server SSH targets when --environment picks the server
cases.reason: Explicit environment selection leaves both another paired-server alias and its own alias to that routed server SSH axis.

cases.title: matches the identical host id
cases.reason: Exact local, SSH and runtime host IDs each match their own filter.

cases.title: treats the routed runtime own local rows as that runtime
cases.reason: Runtime host filter accepts its own locally stamped rows after routing.

cases.title: does not widen local or ssh filters
cases.reason: Local and SSH filters do not expand to another kind of host.

cases.title: does not match a different runtime host
cases.reason: Different runtime identity and null candidate remain excluded from a runtime filter.

cases.title: refuses --host runtime:<name> when two servers share that name
cases.reason: Prefixed runtime human name refuses duplicated pairing-store names.

cases.title: refuses --environment <name> when two servers share that name
cases.reason: Environment-store selector also refuses duplicated pairing-store names.

cases.title: still routes an exact id past a colliding name
cases.reason: Exact environment ID still resolves when display names collide.

cases.title: accepts a paired server by name or id
cases.reason: Exact paired name and exact ID survive as typed, without fetching SSH suggestions.

cases.title: hands back the id for a name typed in another case or quoted
cases.reason: Case-insensitive and wrapped-quoted paired name becomes the canonical store ID.

cases.title: names the SSH target when the selector is one
cases.reason: Wrong-axis environment input offers the exact existing SSH target identity.

cases.title: still points at host list when the name is on neither axis
cases.reason: Unknown selector on both axes retains actionable pairing-store failure.

rationale: Read every original body, parameter input, output assertion and relevant producer/consumer. Preserve host identity and mixed-version output boundaries; repairs strengthen independent expected values and observable file contents.

cases.title: prints structured computer-use startup recovery steps
cases.reason: Actual RPC error formatter preserves structured application-selection recovery and failure context.

cases.title: prints runtime next steps for structured lineage errors
cases.reason: Lineage recovery retains ordered string next steps while filtering a numeric malformed step.

cases.title: preserves orchestration migration recovery in human and JSON errors
cases.reason: Migration refusal preserves human recovery and machine effectsApplied/nextCommandArgs rather than hiding the refusal.

cases.title: includes parent and child workspace relationships in text output
cases.reason: Associate parent/child fields with the independently identified workspace output blocks; previous global substring assertions also passed with relationships attached to the wrong row.

cases.title: shows explicit run context before the legacy repo id
cases.reason: Explicit run project/host/setup/repository/path stays distinct from legacy repo identity in human output.

cases.title: prints visual split groups and nested terminal panes
cases.reason: Nested visual split/group/tab/pane fixture exercises recursive formatter and active markers with distinct stable identities; no real window or native focus is launched.

cases.title: warns limited cursor reads to continue with the next cursor
cases.reason: Limited cursor page directs continuation to the next cursor, retaining oldest and latest context.

cases.title: warns limited tail previews to page retained output from the oldest cursor
cases.reason: Limited tail preview already at latest directs history paging from oldest rather than looping at latest.

cases.title: uses a generic limited warning when only partial output is retained
cases.reason: Partial retention with all cursors equal yields a generic limitation instead of impossible retained-history advice.

cases.title: keeps older runtime read responses readable
cases.reason: Old runtime without new cursor fields remains readable and retains output plus truncation warning.

cases.title: includes routed worktree and explicit window target in the suggested follow-up command
cases.reason: Independently specify native-platform app quoting in the follow-up command instead of deriving expected output with the same production quoting function. Keep explicit routed workspace/window precedence.

cases.title: preserves explicit window-index targeting in the suggested follow-up command
cases.reason: Explicit session and requested window index survive into follow-up command.

cases.title: surfaces action screenshot failures in pretty output
cases.reason: Screenshot failure remains visible while synthetic input stays attempted/unverified; actual follow-up targets its window.

cases.title: does not treat clipboard actions without verification as completed
cases.reason: Clipboard action without verification remains attempted rather than completed, with the path-specific explanation.

cases.title: respects explicit verification metadata on synthetic action results
cases.reason: Explicit verified property overrides generic synthetic-input uncertainty and permits completion text.

cases.title: drops stale requested window selectors after a window-changed fallback
cases.reason: Window-change fallback discards stale requested index and targets replacement window while preserving session and unverified status.

cases.title: uses snapshot window index for follow-up commands when the provider has no stable window id
cases.reason: Use an independent platform-aware quoted application literal while retaining snapshot-index fallback when stable window ID is absent.

cases.title: uses action target window index before snapshot fallback for ID-less providers
cases.reason: Use an independent platform-aware quoted application literal while retaining action-target index precedence over a different snapshot index.

cases.title: shows screenshot dimensions and coordinate scale in pretty state output
cases.reason: Pretty state output retains screenshot dimensions, coordinate scale, ID-less index and visible element count.

cases.title: removes expired screenshot temp files when cleanup is due
cases.reason: Real temporary filesystem expires old screenshots and records cleanup; no timer-speed or implementation-loop count assertion.

cases.title: skips screenshot temp cleanup when the cleanup marker is fresh
cases.reason: Read the actual exported file and require decoded screenshot bytes while a fresh marker retains the old file. A production mutation writing corrupt bytes passed the original case and fails this assertion.

cases.title: keeps inline screenshot data when temp export fails
cases.reason: Actual invalid output directory exercises disk-export failure and preserves inline data without false dataOmitted/path markers.

cases.title: does not rewrite non-computer nested screenshot JSON payloads
cases.reason: Browser-like nested screenshot without computer status retains inline payload and gains no export markers.
